name: @amodalai/example-invoice-approval
description: An Amodal example that reviews vendor invoices against purchase orders and a spend policy: an invoice is pasted as the vendor sent it and an extractor subagent reads it, a durable tool matches it in code and delegates the judgment to a reviewer subagent, an approver watches the review in the inbox and approves, returns, or rejects, four stores keep the invoices, purchase orders, reviews, and events, and a preToolUse guard hook enforces the hard rules platform-wide.

scripts.test: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.app.json --test tests/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/components/*.test.tsx && node --test tests/*.test.mjs

amodal.name: invoice-approval-example
amodal.description: Review vendor invoices against their purchase orders and a fictional spend policy. Paste an invoice as the vendor sent it, watch the agent extract it, match the purchase order, and recommend approve, hold, escalate, or reject with a reason; an approver decides or returns it for a fix. The agent assists; a human decides.
